## EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT PROVIDER NOTE
Arrival: 07/18/2026 02:10 via EMS (found down at bus bench, arousable)
## HPI
41 y/o M, unhoused, h/o alcohol use disorder, brought in intoxicated. Pt slurring, admits drinking "a fifth" of vodka today. Daily drinker ~1 pint/day x 10 yrs. Hx withdrawal seizure 2023. No head strike per EMS.
## Exam
T 97.6F HR 104 BP 146/92 RR 16 SpO2 96% RA
Somnolent but arousable, ataxic gait, nystagmus. No signs of head trauma.
## Data
BAL 312 mg/dL (02:40)
Glucose 92, Na 135, K 3.3 L, CO2 22, AG 12
CT head non-contrast: no acute intracranial abnormality
## ED Course / MDM
Acute alcohol intoxication. Monitored. By 08:00 BAL 168, pt tremulous, CIWA 12 -> lorazepam 2 mg PO.
High risk of complicated withdrawal (prior seizure) -> admit to medicine.
Signed: J. Ortega, MD 07/18/2026 08:50
